library: Acme Pay internal control library (fictional, for the RegRadar demo)

controls.title: Security incident triage and escalation
controls.description: Cyber security incidents detected by the SOC are triaged and escalated internally to the CISO within 24 hours of detection; reporting to regulators is handled case by case by Compliance.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication for privileged access
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all privileged and administrative accounts accessing production systems through the PAM gateway.

controls.title: VAPT of internet-facing applications
controls.description: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing of internet-facing applications is performed annually by an empanelled external auditor.

controls.title: Centralised security log retention
controls.description: System and security logs are centrally retained in the SIEM for 90 days and stored in the Mumbai cloud region within India.

controls.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery plan
controls.description: The business continuity and disaster recovery plan is approved by the board and tested through an annual failover exercise.

controls.title: Pre-onboarding vendor security due diligence
controls.description: Every technology vendor completes a security risk assessment and due diligence review before onboarding is approved.

controls.title: Right-to-audit clause in outsourcing agreements
controls.description: All outsourcing agreements include a standard clause granting the company and the Reserve Bank the right to audit the service provider.

controls.title: Annual critical vendor performance review
controls.description: Critical IT service providers are reviewed annually for service performance, SLA breaches and financial stability.

controls.title: Consent capture and consent ledger
controls.description: Consent from each data principal is captured in the mobile app with the purpose and timestamp of consent, and verifiable consent records are maintained in the consent ledger.

controls.title: Customer data retention schedule
controls.description: A data retention schedule defines retention periods for customer personal data; erasure is performed manually when a customer requests deletion.

controls.title: Privacy notice and grievance contact
controls.description: The privacy notice on the website lists the grievance officer email address for privacy complaints.

controls.title: Board risk committee oversight of technology risk
controls.description: The Risk Management Committee of the board reviews technology and outsourcing risk reports every quarter.

controls.title: Security awareness training
controls.description: Annual cyber security awareness training is mandatory for all employees and contractors.

controls.title: Encryption of data at rest and in transit
controls.description: Cardholder and customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher.

controls.title: Production change approval
controls.description: Changes to production systems require peer review and approval by the change advisory board before deployment.

controls.title: Backup and restoration testing
controls.description: Daily encrypted backups of payment databases are taken and restoration is tested every half-yearly.

known_issues.title: Increase VAPT frequency for internet-facing applications from annual to quarterly
